verdict.rationale: The firm publishes detailed, founder-facing analysis of Indian startup rules and instruments: the 2026 Startup Notification (turnover thresholds, the deep-tech recognition pathway, flip-structure ineligibility) and ESOP tax treatment via the Flipkart options-buyback ruling. However, its cross-border reach is not shown on this story's axis. Offices are India-only, and while the site surfaces 'international CMS legal updates', none is shown covering other markets' startup instruments. Missing for 10: publications on non-Indian instruments (UK EMI, German VSOP, French BSPCE), a dedicated Indian FDI publication (FDI appears only as an M&A practice line), and independent corroboration.
